ValidationRule.description: complaint decision can't be empty when close case for AMFS
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Complaint'), ISPICKVAL(Entity_Backup__c, 'AMFS'), OR(ISPICKVAL(CHS_Status__c, 'Closed - Invalid'), ISPICKVAL(CHS_Status__c, 'Closed - Valid')), ISBLANK(Complaint_Decision__c) ), true, false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complaint Decision can't be empty when closed case complaint
